rows.text: This pile of ore in the mural is offset. It's not symmetrical, and it's going to trigger people's urges.
rows.speaker: Anxious Nymph

rows.text: {RUBY_B#Talanton}The ruler{RUBY_E#} would never let such unbalance go unpunished! Can I chisel a few pieces of this ore off?
rows.speaker: Anxious Nymph
